headline: IDF says Sunday/weekend Gaza strikes killed 4 operatives
dek: IDF says strikes on Sunday Oct 25 killed Alaa Abu Zaid and Hamdan Suleiman Ibrahim Abu Amra (Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives) and Fawzi Salam Odat Allah Sawarha (Hamas sniper operative who had advanced attacks); a Saturday strike killed Mohammed Anan Mohammed al-Rawagh, commander of a cell in…
sources: IDF announcement via Times of Israel liveblog
fault_line: Four named operatives, or 13 people killed — is this ceasefire enforcement or a one-sided toll?

sections.what_happened: IDF says strikes on Sunday Oct 25 killed Alaa Abu Zaid and Hamdan Suleiman Ibrahim Abu Amra (Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives) and Fawzi Salam Odat Allah Sawarha (Hamas sniper operative who had advanced attacks); a Saturday strike killed Mohammed Anan Mohammed al-Rawagh, commander of a cell in Hamas's Nukhba Force. IDF says the four had been advancing attacks on troops and civilians and restoring the two groups' capabilities in 'systematic violation of the ceasefire'. A further Sunday strike bombed a 'military structure' in northern Gaza used as a sniper position targeting IDF forces. Distinct from the IAF Khalawa/Abu-Udeh announcement recorded at 1800-03 (different operatives, different strike dates).
sections.what_verified: IDF's own announcement as reported by Times of Israel (T3 in registry); no independent confirmation of the operatives' roles or of the sniper-position claim.
sections.what_disputed: Gaza Civil Defence spokesman Mahmoud Bassal (via Times of Israel item itself): 13 people killed and about 60 wounded by alleged Israeli fire/airstrikes in Gaza in the past 24 hours — the same toll recorded at 1700-02 (up from AFP's earlier 11 killed / 50 wounded). IDF names 4 operatives killed; civil defence counts 13 dead. The two tallies describe the same 24 hours and do not reconcile on this evidence. Israel's military told AFP it was 'not aware' of activity in Al-Mawasi on Monday (1700-02).
sections.why_matters: Ceasefire toll, two counts: Israel names 4 operatives it says it killed on Sunday; Gaza's civil defence counts 13 dead in the same 24 hours. Both numbers, side by side, the night before Israel votes.
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW (Times of Israel liveblog 19:53 Israel time = 21:53 ) -- IDF says Sunday/weekend Gaza strikes killed 4 operatives; civil defence toll for the same 24 hours is 13 killed

totw_analysis: Our read: Ceasefire toll, two counts: Israel names 4 operatives it says it killed on Sunday; Gaza's civil defence counts 13 dead in the same 24 hours. Both numbers, side by side, the night before Israel votes. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Four named operatives, or 13 people killed — is this ceasefire enforcement or a one-sided toll?
